comparison.objective: Trip a breaker using a named spring-return switch, versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Turn and hold one control until a lamp activates versus multi-stage tool insertion, unlocking, fine adjustment, relocking, and repeated dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Hold TRIP until the green lamp lights; candidate requires two quantified non-bottoming stops and a retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Shared rotary/control actuation is generic. The candidate adds mechanical unlocking, tuning, locking, and measured impact behavior.
